(1) 福州新闻网 2016-12-12, an article whose subject IS 西三线东段吉安—福州段, quoting 刘伟: 「西三线主供气源为新增进口中亚土库曼斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、哈萨克斯坦三国天然气，补充气源为新疆煤制天然气」 — a near-verbatim match to GEM's string apart from the company attribution. Two publishers, two classes (municipal press / SASAC release) -> high, independent. NOT corroborated and flagged: the parenthetical 'produced by Xinwen Company and Qinghua Company' (新汶 / 庆华 coal-to-gas). The Xinjiang coal-to-gas SUPPLEMENT itself is corroborated by the 福州新闻网 quote; the two company names are not — nothing found in this pass names either company against this section or against WEP3's supply mix. What the segment-naming documents DO name: 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司西气东输分公司 (the 建设单位 of the 2021 德化支线-西三线东段 interconnection EIA, filed with 泉州市生态环境局) and its local unit 国家管网集团西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 (PipeChina's own site; 人民网 via ndrc.gov.cn 2021-01-29); NDRC's 2023 tariff table puts 西气东输三线东段（中卫以东）under 国家管网集团经营的跨省天然气管道. The 100% single-owner shape is not in doubt — a national trunk inside the PipeChina group after the 2020-09-30 asset transfer, and 福建省发改委's 2019-01-18 核准 shows the pre-transfer holder was 中国石油管道有限责任公司 (100%) through its 西气东输分公司. RECOMMENDATION: change the operator string to 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司西气东输分公司 (consistent with P4944 / P4946 in this run), and either keep Owner1 as the named subsidiary only if a document is found for it or fall back to the group name 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 as P4947 does. Flagged, not applied.

cross_row_leads.facts: NDRC 2023 跨省天然气管道运价率 attachment (table 国家管网集团经营的跨省天然气管道表) lists the tariff entity as 西气东输三线东段（中卫以东）with 起点 中卫 and 终点 福州 — i.e. for tariff purposes the regulator merges the MIDDLE section (中卫-吉安, your row) with the East Section (吉安-福州) into one 'east of Zhongwei' pipeline. Useful as PipeChina-operation evidence for P4931, but it is NOT a length or capacity source for either row on its own, and its name string must not be read as naming only the East Section. url_verifier: ok=true, 200, pdf, name_found=true.

POINTER, not a verification. This 第一工程机械网 page (2011 article on WEP3 at proposal stage) also carries, in the related-items block of the same fetched body, a summary of the NDRC approval of YOUR section: 「西气东输三线中段工程获批 总投资436.48亿元…国家发改委日前已正式批复同意投资建设西气东输三线中段(中卫—吉安)工程…项目主要工程内容包括1条干线、2条支干线，项目总投资为436.48亿元(含外汇3.3亿美元)。其中：干线起自宁夏中卫，途经宁夏、甘肃、陕西、河南、湖北、湖南、江西7省(区)，止于江西吉安，全长2016公里，管径1219毫米，设计压力12/10兆帕，设计输量300/250亿立方米/年，共设置10座压气站…该项目江西境内管道长度约150公里，在吉安市安福县境内设置1座分输站，向井冈山、安福、永新、莲花等城市供气」 (dateline 6月4日, sourced to 江西省发改委). Chase the underlying 江西省发改委 / NDRC release before citing. Note 436.48亿 covers 1 trunk + 2 branch trunks (RELAUNCH item 3 already lists it as an aggregate). The same block adds 「于2012年开工建设的西三线东段江西境内(吉安-瑞金)工程，截至目前山岭隧道施工已全部贯通，累计建成管道200多公里」.

新华网福州 wire 2014-08-26 (carried by 福州新闻网) — a clean system-level source for the WEP3 mainline row: 「西三线工程全长7378公里，沿线经过新疆、甘肃、宁夏、陕西、河南、湖北、湖南、江西、福建和广东10个省区，年设计输量300亿立方米，上游与中国—中亚天然气管道C线连接。西三线采取分段、分期建设投产的方式，霍尔果斯—中卫为西段，中卫—吉安为中段，吉安—福州为东段。东段和西段工程于2012年10月16日开工，中段工程预计今年年底开工。」plus 「8月25日，随着甘肃瓜州站金口焊接完成，全长2445公里的西气东输三线西段全线贯通」 and 「西三线年输气能力为300亿立方米，全线建成投产后，可向福建供气20亿方」. url_verifier: ok=true, 200, name_found=true.

SASAC 2018-12-14 'Third West-East Gas Pipeline fully completed': the eastern segment's 竣工验收 certificate was issued Dec 9 2018 and 'both the eastern and western segments of the Third West-East Gas Pipeline are finished and fully operational' (the middle section was still under construction then). The segment-level figures in it — 832.4 km, 15 bcm/y, construction start Oct 16 2012, gas from Dec 12 2016 — belong to P4928 and must NOT be staged on the mainline row; the completion/acceptance chronology is what is useful for P4934. url_verifier: ok=true, 200, name_found=true.
